references.text: Earlier command to choose twelve men, one from each tribe, as preparation for crossing the Jordan
Moses set up twelve stone pillars for Israel's twelve tribes, a similar memorial theme
The twelve stones on the high priest's breastplate represented the twelve tribes of Israel
One man from each tribe was chosen to help Moses with the census
Twelve spies were sent out, one from each tribe, to explore the land of Canaan
Jesus chose twelve disciples, reflecting the twelve tribes of Israel
The new Jerusalem has twelve gates and twelve foundations, representing the twelve tribes
